name: Legal Troubles
description: The past caught up with you. Now you're dealing with lawyers, courts, and consequences.

chapters.title: The Summons
chapters.description: A process server showed up at your door. Someone's suing you - they're claiming you defamed them in a battle.

choices.label: Hire a Lawyer
choices.description: This is serious. Get professional help immediately.

choices.label: Ignore It
choices.description: This is probably nothing. They're just trying to scare you.

choices.label: Try to Settle
choices.description: Reach out directly and see if you can make this go away.

chapters.title: Discovery
chapters.description: Your lawyer says this could go either way. They want every bar you've ever written as evidence.

choices.label: Cooperate Fully
choices.description: Give them everything. Truth is your defense.

choices.label: Fight Every Request
choices.description: Make this as difficult as possible for them.

chapters.title: At the Table
chapters.description: They're willing to talk. Their ask? A public apology and a cut of your future earnings.

choices.label: Take the Deal
choices.description: Swallow your pride. Make it go away.

choices.label: Counter Their Offer
choices.description: Negotiate. You'll apologize but no money.

choices.label: Walk Away
choices.description: No deal. See you in court.

chapters.title: Default Judgment
chapters.description: You didn't show up. The court ruled against you automatically. Now they're coming for your money.

choices.label: Pay the Judgment
choices.description: You have no choice now. Pay what the court ordered.

choices.label: Try to Appeal
choices.description: Long shot, but maybe you can get the ruling overturned.

chapters.title: Day in Court
chapters.description: The trial is today. Battle rappers in the gallery. Cameras outside. This is either your vindication or your downfall.

choices.label: Testify with Confidence
choices.description: This is just another performance. Own that stand like a stage.

choices.label: Keep It Simple
choices.description: Just answer the questions. Don't try to be clever.

chapters.title: Sanctions
chapters.description: The judge is pissed. Your tactics backfired. They're considering holding you in contempt.

choices.label: Apologize to the Court
choices.description: Humble yourself. You can't win this fight.

choices.label: Stand Your Ground
choices.description: They can't silence you. This is America.

chapters.title: The Appeal
chapters.description: Your new lawyer found a procedural error. There's a real chance the judgment gets thrown out.

choices.label: See It Through
choices.description: You've come this far. Finish it.

choices.label: Settle From Strength
choices.description: Use the appeal as leverage to negotiate a better deal.

endings.title: Case Dismissed
endings.description: You won. The judge threw out the case with prejudice. You walked out of that courtroom like you just 3-0'd the legal system.

endings.title: Split Decision
endings.description: You won on some counts, lost on others. A small fine. Could have been worse.

endings.title: Out of Court
endings.description: Settled without admitting wrongdoing. Confidential agreement. Life moves on.

endings.title: Public Apology
endings.description: You had to apologize on camera. Social media had a field day. Opponents will use this forever.

endings.title: Garnished Wages
endings.description: The court is taking a cut of everything you earn until the debt is paid. Every battle check hits different now.

endings.title: Judgment Reversed
endings.description: The appeal worked. Judgment overturned. You learned an expensive lesson about ignoring legal papers.

endings.title: Contempt of Court
endings.description: The judge gave you 30 days for contempt. You're calling your manager from county lockup. Your next battle is cancelled.
